title: Otori Emu — Building Our Candy Town♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A few days after Christmas
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
The after-party for our show at the ski resort is gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm all set and ready to go☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's good that you're ready...
But why are you carrying such a big bag?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought we were just bringing snacks and stuff over for today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! These are all snacks♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This bag is full of yummy treats that Mr. Chef made for us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But they aren't just any treats!
It's called the “Funtime☆Housebuilding Kit”!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The “Funtime☆Housebuilding Kit”?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, check it out...! Ta-daa☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: W-Wow...! Look at all the treats☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So many cookies and chocolates.
And they come in a variety of shapes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Look at that. These biscuits look like little bricks, and these chocolates are shaped like doors. Can I ask why they were made like this...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, the idea is to use a bunch of different ones to make your own candy house☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, our own candy houses?!
That sounds super duper fun☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. And we're supposed to use these chocolate pens and such to glue everything together, yes? I'm impressed by how intricate this all is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And most surprising of all is the amount... I think we have enough pieces here to build an entire town instead of just a few houses.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A candy town, you say...?
That certainly has an exciting ring to it...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wanna help build the candy town!
Let's all work on it together☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna build one too♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we celebrate the success of their show while building our candy town?

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll build my house... Right here in the middle☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right in the center of town☆
Then, I'm gonna build mine next to yours!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! I bet it'd be even more fun if you built your house on the other side of mine, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah! It'd be such a fun neighborhood♪
Come build your house over here, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay, sure...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Feels like it's going to be a boisterous neighborhood...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Could you glue these two together for me, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure thing! Just hold them right there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Len, Rui, what are you two making?! It already looks massive...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. After discussing things with Len, we've decided to build a co-housing complex together by pooling all of our pieces.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-That means you have double the pieces as the rest of us! Why didn't I think of that...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm going for triple the pieces!
MEIKO, Rin, will you help me out?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, with three times the pieces, we could build something on the order of a castle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A castle...! That's an excellent idea.
After all, it's always best to dream big!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, in that case...!
It's time for the Tenma Construction Company to start designing the Tenma Castle!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, these biscuits just won't stay together... Nom nom...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, you're still eating the pieces that you can't get to stick together...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Because they're so delicious.
I could eat these endlessly...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Mr. Chef said he worked really hard to make sure they tasted good♪ We've got plenty, so it's okay to nibble on a few of them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's the case, I might have one as well. Which do you recommend, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Our town's complete! This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we have a castle, apartments, roads and parks... It's a fully-fledged town with all the fixings!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and this coating of powdered sugar makes it look like it just snowed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really pretty...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Before I forget, I'm gonna take a picture of it since we all worked really hard to put it together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm gonna take some too!
From lots of different angles♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. A town where we all live together...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I bet we'd have lots and lots of fun every day...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How do your pictures look, you two? Good?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆ We'll send them over to you guys a little later!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, now that we've taken pictures of it, let's see how it tastes. Although, a part of me doesn't want to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, but the chef put quite a lot of effort into making each piece taste delicious!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, Emu, will you do the honors?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, you guys, we're gonna devour this town brick by brick!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Let's eat!
